value.rationale: Classifying the covariance of two complete occupancy-parity frequency classes is an intrinsic question about finite urn models. The theorem gives a sharp all-parameter sign and exact exception set, a nonuniform diffuse-mass extension, a macroscopic intensity limit, and a local sign reversal explaining why ordinary monotone negative-dependence tools fail. These features are not a renamed routine marginal moment.
